get.description: Describe a provider, register, table, variable or set by id or name (a set only by `set/<provider>/<register>/<slug>`). No `ref` lists the providers. Variables show curated metadata, with the provider's text only as a fallback. `evidence=true` adds the provider's original texts, column names, curation locators and linked documents.

Describe a provider, register, table, variable or set by id or name (a set only by `set/<provider>/<register>/<slug>`). No `ref` lists the providers. Variables show curated metadata, with the provider's text only as a fallback. `evidence=true` adds the provider's original texts, column names, curation locators and linked documents.
The catalog's period span, the server version and the steward's presentation.
Which years a register, table or variable exists: per table its periods, gaps (with reason) and releases.
Compare a table's or register's columns at two periods: added, removed and changed (name, type, length, value set).
A document by hash: what it covers, an excerpt and, when available, the full text.
The bytes of a PDF document by its content hash, shown inline.
The documents about a register (including its tables and variables), table, variable or classification.
Search the catalog's documents; without `q`, list them by title. `register` keeps that register's documents.
The review items and notices on a register, table or variable (including its column histories), optionally for one period, table or rule code.
What a variable, table or register replaces, is replaced by or is derived from, with the date and the source's own note. `kind=derived_from` is the lineage.

post.description: The MONA order file for a project_data.json on this data holder's tables: one file per table and delivery, with its columns, row keys, row filter, undeliverable periods and warnings; or `order_blocked` listing every problem.

What a project_data.json would order: per requested variable, the table, period and column name, the periods that cannot be delivered, the row keys and any warnings; or `order_blocked` listing every problem.
Check a project_data.json: every problem with its level. Always 200; `ok` is true when `order` would succeed.

get.description: Find the variables behind column names (up to 200), optionally in one register. Names that match nothing are reported as unmatched.
The columns of a table, a register or a variable's tables over a period, with type, length, value set and role.
Search registers, tables, variables, codes and documents by text, best match first. `tag` keeps only that tag's variables. For exact column names use `resolve`.
Per register, how many variables a search query matches.

A variable's columns over time: per table, column name and period one row, in time order, with the provider's wording and the form (type, value set, flags) where stated. A change of form or wording starts a new row. On a data holder's catalog, also its columns and files over the years it holds. `evidence=true` adds the deliveries behind each row and the curated values that replaced the provider's.

The codes and labels of a value set, by `value_set` hash or `classification`. `parent` steps through a hierarchy one level at a time; `q` searches it. Or give `code` (and `label`) to find the value sets that contain it. The blank code is a code like any other.

CatalogIdentity.description: The catalog version the order was checked against.

ColumnRef.description: A requested variable this column delivers.

binding.description: The variable's position in the source; null for a row key nobody requested.

period.description: The days of this reference the file holds.

spelling.description: The catalog's column name; the file uses `name`.

ColumnRole.description: `ordered`: requested; `row_key`: a key the file needs; `carried`: the parent table's key copied into this one.

Context.description: What the site shell shows. Catalog identity is in every response's `meta`.

oneOf.description:
The hull of the periods served: in steward mode the years held, else the
registers' periods. A timeless period does not count; an ongoing one leaves
`end` null. `null` when every period served is timeless.

reg_meta_version.description: The server's version, which seeds a new project's `reg_meta_version`.

releases.description: Absent for a variable (releases belong to tables) and on a data holder's catalog.

CurationStatement.description: A curated statement that supplied a field of this variable.

DiffChange.description:
One field that differs between the two periods: `spelling`, `type`, `length` or
`value_set`.

body.description: The sections joined by a blank line; `null` for a pdf.

document_title.description: The published document this text is taken from; `null` when unknown.
The published document this text is taken from; `null` when unknown.

register_ingested.description: Whether `register` has any linked document; `null` without `register`.

DocSubject.description: One thing a document is about.

Error.description: The error document `{code, class, message, remediation, fields}`.

EvidenceSpelling.description: A column name the variable is known by (case ignored).

FacetVariable.description: A matched variable: its FQID and label.

code.description: A rule code and its sub-kind, `F7:edition-disagreement`.

Graph.description: The focus, its nodes and the relations between them.

oneOf.description: From the day a succession takes over; `null` when the source states no day.

caveat.description: The source's own words about the relation.

name.description: A register's or table's name, a variable's or class version's label.

Issue.description: A project issue or an order finding, located in the project.

path.description: An RFC 6901 pointer into the project; empty for the whole document.

successor_fqid.description:
The successor a `variable_replaced` finding names, or the successor table of an
undated succession (`table_succession_undated`).

clips.description: Every period that cannot be delivered, also when the order succeeds.

entries.description: Per source, per requested variable in request order, then by period start.

row_keys.description: Per source, then by period start.

Manifest.description: The order file: one file per table and delivery, with its columns.

clips.description: Every requested variable the order delivers less of than requested.

extract_format.description: The project's format, resolved to `dta` when it states none.

files.description: By first appearance in the order, then name.

ManifestClip.description: A requested variable that covers less than the requested period.

ManifestColumn.description: One column of the file, with every requested variable it delivers.

name.description: The exact column name in the file.

stata_name.description: Only on a `dta` order, when `name` is not a valid Stata variable name.

ManifestFile.description: One output file: one of the holder's tables in one delivery.

columns.description: Requested columns in request order, then the row keys.

delivery.description: The authored delivery period; null for a timeless table.

name.description: The file's name without the extension; the runner adds the format's extension.

oneOf.description: Absent: every row of the table.

schema.description: The exact schema and table in the database.

OrderCatalog.description: The catalog generation an order was checked against (`meta`).

OrderClip.description: A requested variable that covers less than the requested period.

OrderEntry.description: One stretch of one requested variable in one table.

binding.description: The variable's position in the source.

period.description: The requested period cut to what the table has; `{start: null, end: null}` for a timeless table.

table.description: The table that serves the period.

OrderProject.description: The project an order was checked for.

project_hash.description: A hash of the project document.

OrderRowKeys.description: A serving table's row-key columns over a period.

OrderValueSet.description: An entry's value set by its content hash.

Override.description: A curated value that replaced the provider's.

oneOf.description: Where the curated value is written.

Period.description: A half-open `[start, end)` of ISO days, `null` for an open end.

ref_day.description: The ISO day the population is stated for.

follow_successor.description: Follow the variable's continues successors after it ends; absent means false.

extract_format.description:
The extract file format. Absent means the order authoring default, `dta`, which
the order file resolves; it is never inserted here. An explicit `null` is
`invalid_field_type`.

name.description: Never blank: an unnamed project is `project_unnamed`.

project_hash.description: A hash of the project document.

ProjectPeriodSegment.description: One contiguous piece of a source period.

ProjectPeriodValue.description:
A period endpoint as written: an int year or a period-token string (`"_default"`
included, which only a scalar source period may hold).

ProjectSource.description: One table, a requested period and its variables.

table.description:
A table's public id: `<provider>/<register>` for a register's implicit table,
else `<provider>/<register>/<table>`.

ProjectSourcePeriod.description: One period, or a sorted list of periods for an interrupted series.

ProjectStudyWindow.description: The optional study window, in plain int years.

Provenance.description: Which artifacts and which project the order binds.

steward.description: The data holder whose tables serve the order.

ProviderText.description: One provider text, the years it covers and the deliveries it comes from.

RegisterFacet.description:
One register's matched variables. `name` and `variables` are present only in the
modes that list them, never `null`.

document_title.description: The published document this text is taken from; `null` when unknown.

ResolvedColumn.description: A requested column and the variables it names.

status.description: `matched` for one variable, `ambiguous` for several, `unmatched` for none.

RowFilter.description: Keep a row whose period value lies in any range.

RowFilterRange.description: Inclusive ISO days; an absent bound means no limit.

RowKeyColumn.description: A row-key column: its variable and the spelling it is delivered under.

SchemaLine.description: One variable under one column name in one table.

period.description: Its period, cut to the requested one.

oneOf.description:
One distinct (code, label) pair, not a value set; its value sets are
`values?code=&label=`.

value_set_count.description: How many value sets in use contain this code and label.

heading.description: The best-matching section's heading; `null` when no section matches.

SearchHit.description: One hit, tagged by its kind.

Segment.description:
One row of the variable's per-period list: a column of one table over one period
with one form and one provider wording. A fact the catalog does not state is left
out, never `null`: no type, no value set, `coded` unknown, and `state` clear (the
default).

column.description: The column name it is delivered under; on a data holder's catalog, the holder's column.

evidence.description: Present only when `evidence` is asked for.

file.description: On a data holder's catalog, the file the holder has the column in.

state.description: Present only when the column is ambiguous; absent means clear.

wording.description: The provider's definition over this period; a change of wording starts a row.

oneOf.description: On a data holder's catalog, the holder's own providers too.

registers.description: On a data holder's catalog, the holder's own registers too.

sets.description: The register's curated sets (groups), in id order.

tags.description: The union of its variables' tags, in public-id order.

unplaced.description: Names of deliveries with no known period.

releases.description: Absent when none, and on a data holder's catalog.

tags.description: The union of the members' tags, in public-id order.

period.description: The whole span; `coverage` has the gaps.

Show.description: A summary tagged by `kind`. Every kind but `root` carries the resolved `fqid`, so a bare-name request gets the id back.

ShowMembership.description: A curated set (group) or tag the variable belongs to.

ShowRegisterSet.description: A register's set; `show` at its fqid has the axes and member facets.

members.description: The members' variable fqids, in public-id order.

ShowRowKey.description: The row-key column's period in this table.

ShowSetAxis.description: A set's distinguishing axis, in curated order.

ShowSetColumn.description: A table and column name the member appears under.

periods.description: The column's periods, in time order.

columns.description: The member's columns, ordered by table then spelling.

facets.description: The member's coordinates in the set's axis order.

ShowTable.description: A register's table; the implicit one has the register's fqid.

tables.description: The tables the variable appears in.

Slot.description: How the column is laid out in the holder's files.

Steward.description: The data holder and the versions of its data.

StewardConfig.description: The data holder's name, logo and description.

order_instructions.description: How a researcher hands in an order.

StewardSearchPage.description: Matches in the data holder's own data, with their own count and cursor.

Storage.description: The expected SQL storage, checked before extraction.

fqid.description: The register, table or variable it is about.

spelling.description: The exact column name in that delivery.

Validation.description: `validate`'s result: `ok` exactly when no issue is an `error`.

total.description: The items matching `q` in the whole set; the set's size without `q`.

ValueSetRef.description: A value set by its hash, with the names sources gave it.

classification.description: The classification this value set belongs to; `null` when none.

VariableEvidence.description: The provider's texts and the curated values behind them.
